two_factor_reset_mail.subject: Your two-factor authentication was turned off
two_factor_reset_mail.preview: An administrator turned off two-factor on your {appName} account
two_factor_reset_mail.heading: Choose a new password to sign in again
two_factor_reset_mail.intro: An administrator of {appName} turned off two-factor authentication on your account and signed you out everywhere. Before you can sign in again, choose a new password with the link below. Then turn two-factor back on from your profile to protect your account.
two_factor_reset_mail.open_link: Open this link to choose a new password:
two_factor_reset_mail.expires: This link expires in {minutes} minutes and works once. After that, ask for a new one with “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page.
two_factor_reset_mail.warning: If you didn’t ask for this, contact support right away.
two_factor_reset_mail.footer: You received this because two-factor authentication was turned off on your account.
